semiconductor_relevance: High — Sinochem Lantian specializes in fluorinated chemicals critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Sinochem Lantian Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of fluorinated chemicals, particularly for the semiconductor industry, where it supplies high-performance materials such as FFKM seals and gaskets. Their products are designed to withstand harsh environments in semiconductor fabrication, ensuring high wafer yield and reliability.
capabilities: Fluorinated elastomers for semiconductor equipment seals

regional_presence.China: The company has major production bases in seven cities across six provinces in China.
